covariates: log GDP per capita PPP (WDI NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD, latest year <= 2021)
pooling: sum Resistant / sum InterpretableAST across years and listed drugs, per country; minimum 20 interpretable isolates
reporting: all outcomes reported, including null results; T3 reported regardless
success: T1 P<0.05 positive AND module coefficient in T2 P<0.05

tests.T1: Spearman: module score vs primary outcome
tests.T2: logit(resistance) ~ module + log consumption + log GDP + region
tests.T3: same model with acquired-not-module, and with total ARG, in place of module (specificity)
tests.T4: change in adjusted R2 from adding the module to covariates only

uninformative_if: fewer than 25 countries with both data types
